events.description: Monica Geller says Dr. Mitchell and Dr. Rosen are here.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green is coming.
Monica Geller says Dr. Mitchell and Dr. Rosen should come in.
Dr. Rosen says Dr. Rosen and Dr. Mitchell brought wine.
Dr. Mitchell tells Monica Geller and Rachel Green to look at the wine and says the wine is from the cellars of Ernest Borgnine and Tova Borgnine.
Dr. Mitchell says Dr. Mitchell and Dr. Rosen could not resist choosing that wine from Ernest Borgnine and Tova Borgnine’s cellars.
Rachel Green says the wine is great and tells everyone present to look at the wine.
Dr. Rosen asks how Monica Geller’s ankle is doing.
Monica Geller starts to describe Monica Geller’s ankle condition.
Monica Geller tells Rachel Green to tell Dr. Rosen and Dr. Mitchell about the ankle and says the ankle is Rachel Green’s ankle.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green’s ankle is feeling a lot better.
Rachel Green tells Dr. Rosen and Dr. Mitchell to sit down and says Rachel Green and Monica Geller will get Dr. Rosen and Dr. Mitchell some glasses.
Rachel Green tells Monica Geller that Rachel Green thinks Rachel Green and Monica Geller should tell Dr. Rosen and Dr. Mitchell who they really are and says the situation will be fine.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller and Rachel Green will get in trouble.
Rachel Green tells Monica Geller to stop being such a wuss and says Monica Geller is being a wuss.
Monica Geller tells Rachel Green to excuse Monica Geller for living in the real world and says Monica Geller lives in the real world.
Dr. Rosen says Monica Geller and Rachel Green still seem normal.
Dr. Mitchell says Monica Geller and Rachel Green are normal.
Dr. Rosen tells Dr. Mitchell to admit that every time Dr. Rosen and Dr. Mitchell go out and meet women at the hospital, the situation turns into a problem.
Dr. Mitchell tells Dr. Rosen to relax and look around, says Monica Geller and Rachel Green are fine, and tells Dr. Rosen to make the gesture Dr. Mitchell demonstrates.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller and Rachel Green are not going to tell Dr. Rosen and Dr. Mitchell who Monica Geller and Rachel Green really are.
Monica Geller says Rachel Green can be such a big baby.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green is not a baby.
Rachel Green swears to God and says Monica Geller gets so uptight whenever Rachel Green and Monica Geller discuss telling Dr. Rosen and Dr. Mitchell the truth about who they really are.
Monica Geller says Rachel Green is such a princess.
Rachel Green says Monica Geller is becoming more and more like Judy Geller every day.
Rachel Green says everyone present is getting going with the evening.
Dr. Rosen says Monica Geller and Rachel Green’s apartment is a great place.
Dr. Rosen asks how long Monica Geller has lived here.
Rachel Green says Monica Geller has lived here about six years.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green moved in a few months ago.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller was supposed to get married but Monica Geller left Barry Farber at the altar.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller knows that leaving Barry Farber at the altar was pretty selfish and says that is typical of Monica Geller.
Monica Geller tells Dr. Mitchell and Dr. Rosen to try the hummus.
Dr. Rosen asks what Monica Geller does for work.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green is a chef at a restaurant uptown.
Rachel Green says that being a chef lets Rachel Green boss people around and that Rachel Green loves to do that.
Dr. Rosen says the hummus is great.
Dr. Mitchell says God blesses the chickpea.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller is so spoiled and declares that this realization is the final straw.
Rachel Green says that back in high school Monica Geller was a cow.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller used to wet the bed.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green uses Rachel Green’s breasts to get other people’s attention.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller and Rachel Green both use their breasts to get other people’s attention.
Dr. Mitchell says the phone caller is Rachel Green’s dad, Leonard Green.
Monica Geller tells Leonard Green that the caller is Monica Geller, says Monica Geller cannot talk right now, and says Monica Geller has been meaning to tell Leonard Green something.
Rachel Green asks everyone present to excuse Rachel Green for a second.
Monica Geller asks Leonard Green to remember back in freshman year.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller and Billy Dreskin had sex on Leonard Green’s bed.
